steps.code:
# Let's fetch all friends pages and count those with friends_since >= 2022-10-01.
all_friends = []
page_index = 0
while True:
    page = apis.venmo.search_friends(access_token=login_result['access_token'], page_index=page_index, page_limit=20)
    if not page:
        break
    all_friends.extend(page)
    page_index += 1

# Count friends made since start of October last year (2022-10-01)
from datetime import datetime
cutoff = datetime(2022, 10, 1)
count = 0
for friend in all_friends:
    friends_since = datetime.fromisoformat(friend['friends_since'])
    if friends_since >= cutoff:
        count += 1

print("Total friends:", len(all_friends))
print("Friends since Oct 1, 2022:", count)
